chunks: To bring better people than they in their place; and they will not be able to thwart Us.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God will replace people with better ones and cannot be thwarted?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine attribute of *Qudrah* (omnipotence) and the inevitability of *Tabdil* (transformation), illustrating that God’s will is never thwarted by human agency. It serves as a reminder of the cyclical nature of history, where righteous communities may be replaced by others who better fulfill their covenant, affirming that God is never 'outwitted' (*ghalib*).
